notes: Dockerfile.final ordering fixed: setup_runtime.sh now runs BEFORE repo_setup.sh to ensure git and system packages are installed before repo_setup.sh attempts to clone the repository. Single-stage build from nvidia/cuda:12.0.1-devel-ubuntu22.04. repo_setup.sh clones NVIDIA DALI repository to /workspace. setup_runtime.sh installs system packages (cmake, build-essential, ninja-build, python3-venv) and creates Python venv at /opt/benchmark/dali_venv with pytest and numpy. eval.sh and test files are intentionally NOT baked into the image as they are runtime-mounted verifier assets. Final WORKDIR is /workspace. Build context files (setup_runtime.sh, repo_setup.sh) are present in /artifacts/environment/. Ready for Buildah validation.
